def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals={}
    for r in g:
        for v in r: vals[v]=vals.get(v,0)+1

    rowsws=[any(g[i][j]==shape for j in range(w)) for i in range(h)]
    i=0

        band=range(i,j)

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals={}
    for r in g:
        for v in r: vals[v]=vals.get(v,0)+1
    bg=max(vals,key=vals.get)
    shape=[v for v in vals if v!=bg][0]
    rowsws=[any(g[i][j]==shape for j in range(w)) for i in range(h)]
    i=0
    while i<h:
        if not rowsws[i]: i+=1; continue
        j=i
        while j<h and rowsws[j]: j+=1
        band=list(range(i,j))
        R=max(b for a in band for b in range(w) if g[a][b]==shape)
        colR=frozenset(a for a in band if g[a][R]==shape)
        p=1
        for d in range(1,R+1):
            if frozenset(a for a in band if g[a][R-d]==shape)==colR:
                p=d; break
        for c in range(R+1,w):
            for a in band:
                src=g[a][c-p] if c-p<=R else g[a][c-p]  # predicted cells already written as 1
                if src==shape or src==1: g[a][c]=1
        i=j
    return g
